question: Which 4 immune cell markers distinguish macrophages (Cluster 7) from T cells (Cluster 9) in the newborn lung?

nodes.label: Identify and extract Cluster 7 (macrophages) and Cluster 9 (T cells) cells from the annotated newborn lung scRNA-seq dataset
Perform appropriate normalization and covariate correction on expression data for the selected clusters to make them comparable
Run differential expression analysis between Cluster 7 and Cluster 9 to identify genes enriched in macrophages versus T cells
Filter DE genes for canonical immune lineage markers that robustly distinguish macrophages from T cells
Rank candidate markers by specificity and expression magnitude and select four macrophage and four T cell markers that best discriminate the clusters
Load newborn lung CELLxGENE AnnData object and subset cells annotated as Cluster 7 (macrophages) and Cluster 9 (T cells) into a new AnnData
On the subset AnnData, perform log1p CPM normalization, scale expression, and regress out n_counts and percent_mito to obtain covariate-corrected expression values
Run differential expression with scanpy.tl.rank_genes_groups comparing Cluster 7 vs Cluster 9 using method='wilcoxon' and store results in adata.uns['rank_genes_groups']

From DE results, intersect significantly enriched genes (adjusted p < 0.05, log2FC > 0.5) with a curated list of canonical macrophage markers (e.g. CD68, MARCO, CSF1R, LILRB4) and T cell markers (e.g. CD3D, CD3E, CD4, CD8A) to retain lineage-specific candidates

For each lineage, compute average expression and detection rate per cluster for candidate markers, rank by log2FC specificity and mean expression, and select four macrophage markers and four T cell markers with highest discriminatory power between Cluster 7 and Cluster 9
